metadata: JSON pointers identify parameters; SI unless key ends mm/deg/rpm. Unspecified source=assumed engineering sensitivity, uncertainty=not quantified; references use manufacturer model or datasheet, not measured robot. No 3 kg rejection gate.

packaging.note: Two orthogonal motor envelopes only; pitch motor rotates with parent roll carrier. No output shank/hand, real gimbal frame, cables or costume. Shaft-line reference, not released horn/bolt interfaces.

cases.note: Four 23g wrist motors replaced with 82g references, +236g; no proof of wrist fit or sustained load capacity. Added support hardware must still fit/change the nonmotor allowance.

leg.note: Symmetric planar fixed-foot model, ankle->knee->hip coordinates q=[alpha,-2alpha,alpha], upper body vertical. Half upper-body lump conserves candidate total mass. Uniform rods approximate inertias. Quintic rest-to-rest extension is NOT takeoff (end velocity zero).

arm.note: Fixed shoulder sagittal lift proxy with equal half payload attached at tip. Not full robot IK, no grasp contact model, no wrist roll or shoulder roll; masses are assumed.

support.note: Quintic force ramp at a fixed wrist lever, not a wholebody getup trajectory.
